senses.def: Any word beginning with v that is not normally taboo but is considered (often humorously) to be so in the given context.
Representing the sound made by teleporting or dematerialising/rematerialising.
ex: A cyclic wheezing, groaning noise began as Vin approach the back wall. The vworp vworp noise was synchronized with a flashing blue light on top, as the gigantic three-dimensional holographic wall displayed a London 1950
A voice cackled all evil-like and then lightning struck the tower and with a vworp it disappeared! Gosh!
